demos.title: AI lecture: LeCun on LLMs (perspectives)
demos.about: Verbatim Yann LeCun quotes (Lex Fridman Podcast #416, 2024, and a 2023 post on X), played as a lecture.

lines.speaker: Yann LeCun
lines.text: They don't really have persistent memory. They can't really reason and they certainly can't plan.

lines.speaker: Yann LeCun
lines.text: The type of reasoning that takes place in LLM is very, very primitive, and the reason you can tell is primitive is because the amount of computation that is spent per token produced is constant.

lines.speaker: Yann LeCun
lines.text: A house cat has way more common sense and understanding of the world than any LLM.

lines.speaker: Yann LeCun
lines.text: If you're really interested in human level AI, abandon the idea of generative AI.
